entities.summary: Joyce Bawah Mogtari is a Ghanaian lawyer and politician who served as a Deputy Minister of Transport in Ghana. She is currently the special aide to the current president of GhanaJohn Dramani Mahama. She is an experienced mediator and has done this on several occasions, both locally and internationally.
